entities.summary: The Roman ruins of São Cucufate is an ancient archaeological site on the ruins of a Roman-era agricultural farm in the civil parish of Vila de Frades in the municipality of Vidigueira, in the southern Alentejo, Portugal. The convent, which dates to the Middle Ages, was dedicated to the martyred saint Cucuphas.
